    def test_load_user(self):

            warnings.simplefilter('error', DeprecationWarning)
            self.assertEqual(load_user(uid=2), {'id': 2})

    def test_callers_do_not_use_deprecated_alias(self):
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter('error', DeprecationWarning)
            self.assertEqual(user_json(3), {'id': 3})
            self.assertEqual(warm([4, 5]), [{'id': 4}, {'id': 5}])
            self.assertEqual(warm([]), [])

    def test_fetch_user_deprecated_alias(self):
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
            warnings.simplefilter('always', DeprecationWarning)
            self.assertEqual(fetch_user(uid=6), {'id': 6})
        self.assertEqual(len(caught), 1)
        self.assertIs(caught[0].category, DeprecationWarning)
        self.assertIn('load_user', str(caught[0].message))
        self.assertEqual(caught[0].filename, __file__)

    def test_fetch_user_delegates_to_load_user(self):
        with patch('users.core.load_user', return_value={'id': 7}) as loader:
            with self.assertWarns(DeprecationWarning):
                self.assertEqual(fetch_user(7), {'id': 7})
        loader.assert_called_once_with(7)
